# SL-19S E2 dry run on stipulated parameters

**Stipulated parameters (A17), pre-E1, exploratory.** Results of `python -m features.storelab.analysis.e2_run` (master seed 2026102319), regenerated by `python -m features.storelab.analysis.e2_report`. These are stand-ins (A17), not estimates of any agent: no statistic below is a finding, and no decision label is recorded.

## Design

- 165 configurations, 33004 markets, six mechanisms each (SL-16 solvers). Core: α × organic regime × organic variation at the A17 baseline (30). Sensitivity: the 24 A17 levels E2 uses, over α in the agent-aware regime without organic variation (120). Part 3 of H2a: the model and version levels in the human-optimised regime (15). Owner decisions 2026-10-23.
- Guardrail floor (owner decision 2026-10-23): M(Q) ≥ min{(1 − κ) M^ref, M(Q^o, ∅) − 1e-8 n}; it binds in 10912 of 33000 markets.
- Prop gating and Conj gating use the paper's guardrail: 200 markets per κ ∈ {0.05, 0.2}, and Conj gating at κ = 0.05 over α on the 253 markets whose gated design meets the paper's guardrail at every α (drawn until at least 200; at α = 0 and 0.25 the gated list often cannot meet it).
- A configuration with solver exclusions is topped up with further markets (index 200, 201, ...) until 200 are valid; `e2_run` does this itself, so a seeded rerun reproduces it.

## Markets (AC-1)

Every configuration: 200–200 valid markets, at most 2 excluded (solver failure) per configuration, one input hash per market across the six mechanisms in every configuration: yes. Screen-failing (A1 §E5) and aware-infeasible (`cor:aware`) markets are classified and left out of H2a part 1 (counts in `e2_stipulated_results.json`). QP solves that needed SL-16's fallback path: 74489.

## Implementation gates (AC-3)

| Gate | Result | Tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Prop gating, κ = 0.05: max relative error of Π_b − Π_a against n ξ min{θ_f, θ_r} (200 markets) | 8.6e-08 | 1e-6 |
| Prop gating, κ = 0.05: mean gain / (n ξ) 0.3144 against E min = 1/3 | 1.16 MC SE | 3 MC SE |
| Prop gating, κ = 0.2: max relative error of Π_b − Π_a against n ξ min{θ_f, θ_r} (200 markets) | 8.6e-08 | 1e-6 |
| Prop gating, κ = 0.2: mean gain / (n ξ) 0.3144 against E min = 1/3 | 1.16 MC SE | 3 MC SE |
| Set-blind gap with deterministic organic lists, max (V^aw − V^bl)/V^aw (30000 markets) | 9.2e-16 | 1e-6 |

Both gates pass.
